findings.description: F001 still contains stale substrate-posture wording: internal substrate plans are described as advisory unless opted in, which conflicts with the D030/D043 rule that any consumer-journey-bearing plan, including substrate, blocks an undeferred unproven outcome.
findings.recommendation: Replace the stale wording with the exact D030 posture rule: warn only for substrate plus opt-in plus no consumer journeys; otherwise consumer-journey-bearing plans block when unproven.

findings.description: F001 preserves binary consumer=both language stating both families must be proven and a missing family is unproven, but the locked contract requires the D035 carve-out where a required human family with not_yet_typed evidence becomes consumer_outcome_pending and does not block.
findings.recommendation: Qualify every consumer=both rule with the D035 status table before lock: enforced agent missing or unproven blocks; typed-but-unsatisfied families block; human not_yet_typed is advisory pending.

findings.description: The seeded-evidence test only pins seeded-only screenshots on a non-fixture_only journey, leaving ambiguity about whether a fixture_only seeded journey could accidentally satisfy the close-time real-execution requirement.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit test or contract sentence that no seeded-only journey, including any fixture_only variant, satisfies the close-time consumer outcome for product-class objective claims.
